title: Pan-Seared Salmon Udon Noodles
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared salmon and udon noodles in a savory sauce.

ingredients.name: flower
ingredients.notes: green onions or edible flowers for garnish

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the udon noodles according to package instructions.
While the noodles cook, season the salmon fillet with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add sesame oil.
Sear the salmon fillet for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and grated ginger.
Add the cooked noodles to the bowl and toss with the sauce.
Serve the noodles with the pan-seared salmon on top and garnish with green onions or edible flowers.
Enjoy your delicious Pan-Seared Salmon Udon Noodles!
